scope: Fixture-only state, label, product container class and scoped action font-size. No product source changes; no fixture source or public output changes; no builds, tests, server or browser actions.

control.label: Action text scale (fixture only)
control.measurementSource: Root actual browser measurement; candidate browser measurement still pending

remountBehavior: Control only calls setActionTextScale. Existing mounted state, mountKey, PhoneApp key, LocaleProvider, product handlers and seed/origin/owner safeguards are byte-preserved.
acceptance: Root will apply, rebuild and measure actual Arabic action wrapping at 390/320 CSS pixels. This is a fixture-only action-text stress condition, not native large-text, browser zoom, WCAG resize-text or device acceptance.
